content.text:
**Pricing basis:** The batch job's cost was priced using the Databricks Jobs compute rate of **$0.45/DBU** (REFERENCE_ONLY status, sourced from `system.billing.list_prices`). No single component DBU-per-hour value was supplied, so the calculator applied its **planning default DBU-per-hour rate** for component B1 to convert the 20 runs/month × 2 hours/run into DBUs, then priced those DBUs at the list rate.

**Confidence — LOW:** 100% of the EXPECTED recurring cost rests on planning assumptions (the default DBU/hour intensity), with 0% derived from team-supplied ranges or confirmed figures. This is the calculator's own threshold rule: once planning-assumption share reaches 50% or more of recurring cost, confidence is capped at LOW.

**Assumption used:** B1's compute intensity relied on the `PLANNING_DEFAULT_DBU_PER_HOUR` basis — i.e., no confirmed or historically calibrated DBU/hour was provided for this batch job.

**Warning:** The rate used is a list price for testing purposes; production estimates would use the governed account rate from `system.billing.account_prices`, which may differ from this figure.

**Pending items:** None — all inputs needed for the included processing area were supplied, so there are no PENDING line items in this estimate.
